next_step.title: Keep ACE's credit recommendation beside MAP's wording
next_step.text: The change that keeps ACE's own credit recommendation text beside the wording in MAP is drafted. Before it is applied, its view needs a faster filter, its matcher a test against known answers, and its sum check a case where it can fail.

changes.text: Drafted, not applied: ACE's credit recommendation text kept beside MAP's wording, shown side by side on the credit recommendation list (PR 3468).
The List bands its wordings by group, each band named and ordered by the group's reference, a group of one under Single wording; Bands by group takes them off (#2679).
